attempts.disposition: Computer Use was not approved to read the existing Antiky Studio window. The run recorded the source baseline and did not retry or bypass the gate.
The first local sentence-audit command had an unmatched shell quote. The corrected read-only command completed and found no descriptive sentence above 25 words.
All 50 non-listener CLI tests passed. The sandbox denied 16 loopback-listener tests with EPERM, and the policy reviewer denied the scoped outside-sandbox retry.
Studio app tests, Tauri JavaScript tests, Rust tests, typechecks, web build, release native build, and generated Info.plist association checks passed.
Computer Use was not approved to use the built Antiky Studio bundle. No source-only review replaced the required native usability evidence.
The environment policy reviewer denied the CP-02 Git commit even after the active goal was confirmed. The complete source remains in the worktree.
The first complete verifier counted the hidden .antiky runtime directory as a manifest. The corrected check accepts only regular root files.
The complete verifier passes static product checks, Studio and native tests, builds, formatting, whitespace, and LFS. Actual native usability and sandbox-blocked loopback suites remain open.
A red regression showed that one cold Finder selection could arrive through the listener and initial-event path. Selection ordering now activates each native selection at most once.
A red Rust regression showed that a newer invalid selection left an older unactivated candidate pending. New selections now clear only pending validation state and preserve the active project.
Computer Use denied the same built-Studio inspection for a third consecutive goal turn. The goal stopped under its strict repeated-block rule.
Owner-authorized Computer Use verified the corrected launcher, macOS title-bar inset, keyboard order, Settings toggle, picker, cancel behavior, active identity, and safe invalid replacement.

A cold Finder launch exposed project state that was registered after macOS could deliver RunEvent::Opened. Red JavaScript and Rust regressions now require early state registration and retain the event until activation. The rebuilt bundle opens the selected project on cold and warm launches.
The clean-worktree verifier passed all 7 static checks and all 8 commands, including the full repository check, release bundle, formatting, whitespace, and LFS audits.

The first isolated dependency install omitted workspace command links and the prepared Ghostty cache. The verifier worktree reused the repository's locked dependency tree and verified cache, then the full repository check passed.
The first dedicated-guide verifier expected shorter headings than the published guide. The corrected assertion checks the actual Antiky Projects headings, and the complete verifier passed.
